assets.title: Decorative route repeat tiles — light and dark

pixel_observation.note: Six anti-aliased nonzero-alpha pixels enter the nominal outer25percent transparent margin; no edge pixels are nonzero.
The visible motif extends beyond the nominal central40percent height and the nominal pure-black background has low-level RGB edge variation.

observations: The light source/output is an intentional RGBA transparent tile with three clean dark/amber branching motifs; the 800x800 output composited on warm paper #F4EEE2 has no visible rectangle.
The dark generation-007 source/output is an opaque RGB tile with three clean ivory/amber branching motifs; the 800x800 output viewed in a 3x3 repeat has no visible seam or rectangular boundary.
No text, border, logo, dots, arrowheads, shadow, gameplay route map, screenshot, status, or metric was observed; the motif remains decorative and subordinate.

The strict generation prompt directions are retained as measured observations: six/three nonzero-alpha pixels in the light nominal outer25percent margin, dark source/output motif placement beyond the nominal central40percent height, and dark edge/background channel variation up to [2,1,1]. The authoritative ART_MAP/PROMPTBOOK brief requires a sparse repeatable branching decorative motif; under that brief-level decision boundary, the visible pair is conditionally recommended for acceptance rather than blocked.

issues.finding: Byte-level alpha, central-placement, and pure-black background directions from the selected ROOT prompts are not fully met, although no visible repeat defect was found.
issues.required_follow_up: Keep these deviations in provenance. If a downstream consumer promotes any prompt pixel direction to a hard export invariant, obtain a separate exact repair and rerun pixel and repeat checks.

assets.source_use_observation: Only local root-generated decorative motif sources were used; no external visual reference or product imagery was observed.
assets.evidence_boundary: Decorative background artwork only; it proves no product, game, runtime, status, deployment, or publication behavior.

pixel_observation.note: Six anti-aliased nonzero-alpha pixels enter the nominal outer25percent transparent margin; no edge pixels are nonzero.

limits: The conditional recommendation is a visual/source decision under the ART_MAP/PROMPTBOOK brief; it is not byte-level conformance certification for the stricter ROOT prompt directions.
No consuming website/page integration or public publication was exercised.

repeat_check.light_repeat_visual_result: No visible rectangular boundary at normal display size.
repeat_check.dark_repeat_visual_result: No visible tile seam or rectangular edge at normal display size.

promptbook.relevant_reference: BG-04 lines 273-294: sparse repeatable branching line motif, decorative only, required light/dark exports, independent review gate.

relevant_rules: The Climb — by AI Ascension is the series identity.
Use warm paper, ink, amber, branching paths, and restrained editorial typography.
Use visible evidence labels and do not present generated art as gameplay or product evidence.
Use approved generated identity exports when available; do not silently introduce an unverified logo or monogram.

identity_reference.use: Local generated identity reference named by the GH social route; no trademark or rights determination.
